elev.$description: Elevation levels (UX.TOKENS.SPACE), at most five. Every level is also shown by its surface and border cue ($extensions org.metrologymaven.elevation, names of sem.surface.* and sem.border.* tokens), so the high-contrast theme can show elevation without shadows. In every theme, no two levels resolve to the same surface and border colours.

1.$description: Raised: cards and panels, outlined by the subtle border.

2.$description: Overlay: menus, popovers and dialogs (a dialog also sits above a scrim), outlined by the strong border.
